bigIdea: A dental van parked at the school reaches the children a clinic never sees, and $250 keeps one child out of pain for a year.

beats.name: Client/Context
beats.claim: In Ridley County, one child in three has never seen a dentist.

beats.name: Challenge
beats.claim: The nearest clinic is 40 miles away, and parents cannot miss a day of work.

beats.name: Approach
beats.claim: The van parks at the school, so a child misses one class, not one day.

beats.name: Results
beats.claim: In two years the van has seen 1,180 children, and untreated decay among them fell by half.

beats.name: Lessons
beats.claim: Children come back when the van comes back on the same day each month.

beats.name: Transfer
beats.claim: $250 keeps one child out of pain for a year, and three more schools are waiting for the van.
